description: Add structural Python symbol indexing and bounded snippet extraction to the context pipeline, selecting relevant classes, functions, and methods while retaining safe complete-file fallback for unsupported or unsafe extraction.
acceptance_criteria: The symbol index reports classes, functions, and methods with stable names and exact source line ranges.
Snippet selection uses task terms, graph relationships, explicit references, and related tests without exceeding the context budget.
Selected snippets record path, symbol, start_line, end_line, hash, token estimate, and inclusion reason.
Imports, decorators, class context, and required surrounding syntax are preserved or the compiler falls back to the complete file.
Tests cover nested symbols, malformed Python, empty matches, deterministic ordering, line boundaries, budget limits, and fallback behavior.

planning.title: Add Python symbol and snippet retrieval
